{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Parse revenue: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Confirm parsing worked
print(f"First 5 parsed revenue values: {df['revenue'].head().tolist()}")

# Check for QA orders again after parsing (though they were already confirmed as 0)
print(f"Number of QA orders (revenue == 999999.99): {df[df['revenue'] == 999999.99].shape[0]}")

# Check for refunded orders
print(f"Number of refunded orders: {df[df['status'] == 'refunded'].shape[0]}")

# Check that revenue is now numeric
df.dtypes"}
